title: Zipkin V2 -> OTLP translation bridge with compression negotiation and archival hook
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a lightweight translation bridge that accepts Zipkin v2 JSON/HTTP payloads from legacy instrumentations (mobile SDKs, older services) and emits OTLP spans via gRPC to our collector pool. The bridge must: (1) negotiate Content-Encoding (gzip/identity) and decompress safely, (2) map Zipkin fields (traceId, parentId, id, localEndpoint/serviceName, tags) to OTLP resource/span attributes with a configurable attribute whitelist, (3) enforce span-size trimming and tag cardinality limits to protect collector memory, (4) optionally write raw original Zipkin payloads to S3 archival for downstream forensic analysis, and (5) expose metrics and traces for the bridge itself (ingest_latency_ms, conversion_error_count, dropped_spans_ratio, outgoing_otlp_latency). Acceptance criteria: end-to-end conversion correctness (test vectors), less than 0.1% conversion error on canary traffic, <0.05s added p50 latency on synthetic load, configurable archival toggle, and feature-flagged rollout path with canary and automated rollback on elevated error/latency thresholds.

2026-02-27 - Liam Rivera: Spike completed - prototype reads Zipkin v2 array payloads and converts to OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest. Found two tricky mappings: Zipkin 128-bit trace IDs vs OTLP expectations, and Zipkin's annotation timestamps (ms) vs OTLP ns. Documented in design doc.

2026-03-01 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/compare/feat/zipkin-bridge (WIP). Initial conversion and unit tests for id/ts mappings. Benchmarked single-threaded conversion: ~12k spans/s for small spans.

2026-03-03 - Code review: requested changes around safe gzip decompression to avoid zip bombs. Added limit on uncompressed size (20MB per request) and streaming decompression paths. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/428

2026-03-06 - Design decision: Implement two archival modes: sample-based (1 in N payloads) and size-triggered (payloads > X KB). S3 path format: s3://obs-archive/zipkin/YYYY/MM/DD/service/uuid.json.gz. Archival disabled by default; enabled via runtime config and RBACed bucket keys.

2026-03-08 - Integration test: Added metamorphic tests for tag cardinality trimming. Behavior: trim to top-50 tags by frequency and add _redwood_trimmed_tag_count attribute. Tests pass locally; CI flaky under high memory, need additional memory tuning in container spec.
2026-03-10 - Ready for canary: created canary rollout plan and dashboard. Need security review for S3 IAM role and envelope encryption. Assigned security review.
